title: ConnectionReady
description: Answer to a successful handshake. An ack, not an event: it acknowledges the command that caused it.

limits.description: What this server will accept, so the client does not have to discover it by being refused.

maxFrameBytes.description: Largest frame accepted, in bytes. Over it: `error` PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, and the socket stays.

maxFramesPerSecond.description: Frames a client may send per second. Over it: `error` RATE_LIMITED with `params.retryAfterSeconds`; sending again inside that window closes with 4429.

maxAttachedSessions.description: Sessions one connection may watch at once. `session.attach` or `session.start` beyond it: `error` RATE_LIMITED.
